FAMILY 14 · 2D→3D 与神经场2D-to-3D & Neural Fields

PhyDiCT

在固定预训练三维扩散先验上交替施加投影观测约束与去噪更新；文本报告、几何和预训练权重都是显式条件。

A frozen text-conditioned 3D diffusion prior is guided by differentiable projection consistency during inference; reports, geometry and pretrained weights are explicit conditions.

INPUT / 输入稀疏 X 光、采集几何、文本报告条件与预训练 MedSyn 权重Sparse X-rays, acquisition geometry, a report condition and pretrained MedSyn weights
OUTPUT / 输出与观测相容的三维肺部 CT 候选体；仍需验证患者特异性与域外可靠性A candidate 3D lung CT volume; patient-specific fidelity and external reliability still require validation
SOURCE ROUTE · ADDED 2026-10-17

来源学习与机制地图Source study and method map

READING ORDER / 阅读顺序

先明确必要条件Declare every required input

  1. 01
    观测与几何Observations and geometry先说明 X 光数量、角度、尺度与坐标；真实投影必须与渲染器一致。Specify projection count, angles, scale and coordinates.
  2. 02
    冻结先验与报告Frozen prior and report预训练 MedSyn 权重与文本条件是显式信息，不能当作无需代价的输入。Pretrained MedSyn weights and text conditions are explicit information.
  3. 03
    引导采样Guided sampling作者源码交替执行去噪和投影误差引导；本库尚未运行该路径。The author code alternates denoising and projection guidance; this path has not run locally.
  4. 04
    细化与验证Refinement and validation输出的观测一致性、三维结构和资源消耗应分开验收。Assess projection agreement, 3D fidelity and resource use separately.
REPRODUCTION BOUNDARY / 复现边界
原始路径已核，本地尚待适配。
